unavailable.title: Server unavailable
unavailable.body: Could not get the session state. Check your connection and try again: until the server answers, it is unknown who you are and what you can access.

demo.title: Server demo
demo.subtitle: Data lives in the tab memory, no backend needed.

fresh_install.title: Fresh install
fresh_install.hint: No administrator yet: the first-run wizard is waiting.

admin_ready.title: Administrator
admin_ready.hint: The instance administrator is signed in, admin area is available.

admin_scale.title: Large installation
admin_scale.hint: Administrator with 12,000 people, 800 organizations and 250,000 audit entries: search, filters and paging.

student_ready.title: Student
student_ready.hint: A regular organisation member is signed in.

newcomer.title: Newcomer
newcomer.hint: First sign-in: no projects and no organizations.

registration_closed.title: Registration closed
registration_closed.hint: Only existing accounts can sign in.

sso_only.title: SSO only
sso_only.hint: Passwords are off, sign-in goes through external providers.

registration_domains.title: Registration by domain
registration_domains.hint: Allowed domains only, emails are sent.

admin_env_locked.title: Admin, environment-set
admin_env_locked.hint: Registration and mail are set by the environment: read-only.

admin_sso.title: Admin, SSO only
admin_sso.hint: Password is off, two providers, no mail.

admin_no_orgs.title: Admin, no organizations
admin_no_orgs.hint: The organization list is empty: create the first one.

ops_runners_offline.title: Admin, runners offline
ops_runners_offline.hint: Every runner is silent and jobs pile up in the queue.

ops_services_degraded.title: Admin, services failing
ops_services_degraded.hint: Storage and LanguageTool are down and disk is almost full.

ops_fresh.title: Admin, fresh install
ops_fresh.hint: No runners, no jobs, services not connected.

install_env_locked.title: Admin, environment-set settings
install_env_locked.hint: Address, build limit and key policy are set by the environment.

install_fresh.title: Admin, factory settings
install_fresh.hint: Factory values, key storage forbidden, no shared providers.

org_admin.title: Organization admin
org_admin.hint: Not an installation admin: sees only their two organizations.

registration_open_nosmtp.title: Open, no email
registration_open_nosmtp.hint: Emails are not sent: links are shown on screen.

fresh_install_env.title: Install, admin from env
fresh_install_env.hint: The admin is already created by the environment and the sign-up mode is set: the wizard is read-only.

fresh_install_raced.title: Setup already in progress
fresh_install_raced.hint: Someone else created the admin: neutral screen and a sign-in form.

fresh_install_broken.title: Install, storage is down
fresh_install_broken.hint: The environment check is red: setup cannot be finished.

student_nosmtp.title: Student, no email
student_nosmtp.hint: A student is signed in and email is not configured: links appear on screen.

student_sso.title: Student, SSO sign-in
student_sso.hint: A student is signed in and the account has no password.

student_linked.title: Student, password and SSO
student_linked.hint: A student is signed in with a password and linked HSE SSO; Google can be linked.
